outputCopy.heroIntroduction: Pharmacy First can help with eligible common conditions for people in Allestree.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Allestree is a well-established neighbourhood ward located within the city of Derby. Local civic engagement is spearheaded by a dedicated Neighbourhood Board made up of local ward councillors, residents, and representatives from public services and community organisations. The area benefits from active local groups, including the Allestree Carnival community organisation and the Friends of Allestree Park group.

Key landmarks situated across the ward include the expansive Allestree Park, the local War Memorial, and Allestree Memorial Hall. The neighbourhood is also served by a public library that provides an important community facility. NHS general practice medical services in Allestree are provided from two main sites: Park Lane Surgery and Park Farm Medical Centre.

Pharmacy First provides another way for eligible patients to seek help for certain common health conditions. A pharmacist can assess symptoms, consider relevant medicines and medical history, and explain the most appropriate next step. Depending on the clinical assessment, this may include advice, suitable treatment or referral to another healthcare professional.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby in Derby. Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby is approximately 4.1 km in a straight line from Allestree.
